item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"It patches `litellm.completion` and inspects `mock_completion.call_args.kwargs`, matching the chat path described in the evidence."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"It sets `default_headers` in `dspy.LM(...)` and passes separate per-call `headers=...` on `lm(...)`, directly exercising constructor/request-time kwarg merging."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"It prints and asserts that `call_kwargs[\"default_headers\"]` remains exactly `{\"X-Trace-ID\": \"trace-123\"}` and is not merged into ordinary `headers`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"It asserts the runtime `Authorization` header is preserved and that `headers[\"User-Agent\"]` was added, showing DSPy augments request headers with identification."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"It explicitly asserts `\"X-Trace-ID\" not in call_kwargs[\"headers\"]`, proving the tracing header from `default_headers` was not copied into request headers."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
